results: Role/tenant authorization for every RM-012 endpoint
Detect seated / expected / arrived without changing any row
Release only selected old booking and preserve current-day booking/assignments
Wrong date and stale version are refused atomically
No absence inferred; arrived correction requires a reason and separate confirmation
Client served without tracking can be regularized with a mandatory reason
Lost mutation response retries the same operation exactly once
Ongoing current day and future days are protected even through legacy close
Pending reservations prevent administrative closure
Unexpired draft hold blocks closure; expiry does not imply booking absence
Finalized service closes exact date, archives totals and actual closing timestamp
Closing retries from two managers produce one archive and one closing trace
Concurrent managers cannot regularize one stale reservation twice
Concurrent closing transactions are serialized and idempotent
All old dates are retrievable through cursor pagination and exact selection
Weekly hours and estimated booking end override fixed 23:30
Paris midnight protects the new day while keeping the previous service selected
DST conversion uses local calendar edges, including an overnight period
Audit is immutable, venue-scoped, and keeps a late correction’s actual timestamp
Legacy historical status changes are also audited without bypassing Reception rights
Missing hours fail closed; empty old date remains explicitly selectable
Security catalog: invoker public wrappers, fixed search_path, no anon execution, no writer bypass
Migration reapplication preserves existing rows, settings, archives and schema privileges
Notification snapshots retain ALL unresolved dates independently of list pagination
Closure archive has its own cursor even when no pending-day cursor exists
An active hold alone makes an old day discoverable and blocks its closure
Closing serializes with a concurrent legacy booking insert into the same day
Even the Reception internal writer cannot add an active hold to a closed day
Hosted-style non-superuser rollback and apply/reapply preserve schema privileges
